name: awesome-weekly-robotics
desc: A list of projects that were or will be featured in Weekly Robotics newsletter

resources.name: TurtleBot
resources.desc: A popular, low-cost, personal robot kit with open-source software, created at Willow Garage. Licence: The preferred license for TurtleBot hardware documentation is the FreeBSD Documentation License.

resources.name: NASA Open Source Rover
resources.desc: A build-it-yourself, 6-wheel rover based on the rovers on Mars. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Sawppy Rover
resources.desc: A 3D printed motorized model of Mars rovers Curiosity and Mars 2020 that can be built on $500 budget. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: DonkeyCar
resources.desc: DIY self-driving platform for small scale cars. Requires an R/C car, Raspberry Pi and is programmed in Python. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: MORPH: Modular Open Robotics Platform for Hackers
resources.desc: An affordable modular differential drive platform for open robotics development for hackers. Licence: GPLv3.

resources.name: Linorobot
resources.desc: ROS Compatible ground robots (2WD, 4WD, Ackermann Steering, Mecanum Drive). Licence: BSD-2 Clause.

resources.name: MuSHR
resources.desc: An open-source robotic hardware and software platform for learning and researching AI in a the setting of autonomous vehicles and mobile robotics. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: SCUTTLE
resources.desc: Open source differential-drive robot designed to support teaching within Multidisciplinary Engineering Technology (MXET) at Texas A&M. The bot is a payload-capable mobile platform that is made of readily-available off-the-shelf parts and 3D printed designs. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Mars-Rover
resources.desc: Curiosity/Perseverance inspired Rover with open source hardware and software (C++). Licence: MIT.

resources.name: OpenRobot
resources.desc: $50 robot car that interfaces with smartphone for high level control. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: OpenMower
resources.desc: an open-source, RTK-GPS enabled mower project. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

resources.name: Maker's Pet
resources.desc: a $100 open-source ROS2 home pet robot. This 3D-printed robot runs micro-ROS on Arduino ESP32 to cut down the cost and is compatible with $15 laser distance sensors from used Xiaomi 1st-gen robot vacuum cleaners. License: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: LeKiwi
resources.desc: small omnidirectional robot with an SO-ARM100 attached to it. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Dexter
resources.desc: Open Source industrial robotics arm project. For more information please see Haddington Dynamics webpage. Licence: GPLv3.

resources.name: Reachy 2019
resources.desc: A 7-DOF prosthesis robotic arm developed by Pollen Robotics. The software is licenced under LGPL licence while hardware is licenced under CC BY-SA.

resources.name: Faze4
resources.desc: Faze4 is small fully 3d printable Open source 6 axis robotic arm. It is functionally and esthetically similar to robotic arms in industry but is aimed for research, education and anyone interested in making his own robot arm. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: SO-ARM100
resources.desc: Open Source 3D printable low-cost robot arm for accessible end-to-end learning. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Pedro
resources.desc: A small, 3D-printed robotic manupulator with 3 Degress of Freedom. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: OpenArm
resources.desc: A bimanual manipulator setup with a BOM cost of around $6,500 and 7 DoF and 6kg payload per arm. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Stanford Doggo
resources.desc: Stanford Doggo is a highly agile robot designed to provide an accessible platform for legged robot research. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: mjbots quad A0
resources.desc: The mjbots quad A0 is a small dynamic quadruped, like the MIT mini-Cheetah, but fully open source. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Stanford Quadruped (Pupper)
resources.desc: A low cost quadruped robot with the BoM coming to around $600-900 depending on what components you already have. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Open Dynamic Robot Initiative
resources.desc: An Open Torque-Controlled Modular Robot Architecture for Legged Locomotion Research. Licence: BSD-3.

resources.name: Sesame Robot
resources.desc: ESP32-based low-cost quadruped robot. Locence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Open Duck Mini v2
resources.desc: A miniaturized version of Disney's BDX droid. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Poppy Humanoid
resources.desc: An open-source and 3D printed humanoid robot. Licence: Hardware CC BY-SA, Software: GPL v3.

resources.name: bam
resources.desc: A handy tool for characterizing actuator friction for better modeling for simulations. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: OpenMV
resources.desc: The OpenMV project is about creating low-cost, extensible, Python powered, machine vision modules and aims at becoming the “Arduino of Machine Vision“. Hardware Licence: CC BY-SA 3.0, Software Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Open-Source Leg
resources.desc: Open-source actuated leg prosthetics with a total cost of approx. $28.5k to produce. Licence: CC BY 3.0.

resources.name: Open MCT
resources.desc: Open MCT (Open Mission Control Technologies) is a next-generation mission control framework for visualization of data on desktop and mobile devices. It is developed at NASA's Ames Research Center, and is being used by NASA for data analysis of spacecraft missions, as well as planning and operation of experimental rover systems. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: soft robotics toolkit
resources.desc: The Soft Robotics Toolkit is a collection of shared resources to support the design, fabrication, modeling, characterization, and control of soft robotic devices. The Toolkit was developed as part of educational research being undertaken in the Harvard Biodesign Lab. Licence: Open for research purposes, need to contact the organization for commercial usages.

resources.name: Punyo
resources.desc: Soft Bubble Grippers for Robust and Perceptive Manipulation from Toyota Research Institute. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.

resources.name: Cycloidal Reduction Drive Generator
resources.desc: A cycloidal reduction drive generator script for Autodesk Fusion360. Licence: Public Domain.

resources.name: Pointcloudprinter
resources.desc: Prepare pointclouds from aerial LIDAR scans for 3D printing. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: LinuxCNC
resources.desc: Open Source software that can drive milling machines, lathes, 3d printers, laser cutters, plasma cutters, robot arms, hexapods, and more. Licence: GPLv2.

resources.name: Freeloader
resources.desc: A low cost, desktop size, open source, universal testing machine, designed for inexpensive high-throughput material testing. Licence: BSD (according to the paper).

resources.name: DIY-CNC-machine
resources.desc: A very thorough DIY build of a CNC machine based on a Makita router with a very permissive licence.

resources.name: KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite
resources.desc: Vision benchmark captured in Karlsruhe, contains data fro LiDAR, GPS and stereo cameras. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.

resources.name: FLIR Thermal Dataset
resources.desc: Synced annotated thermal imagery and non-annotated RGB imagery for reference for ADAS research. Contains over 14k images.

resources.name: nuScenes dataset
resources.desc: Autonomous vehicle dataset that includes approximately 1.4M camera images, 390k LIDAR sweeps, 1.4M RADAR sweeps and 1.4M object bounding boxes in 40k keyframes.

resources.name: UZH-FPV Drone Racing Dataset
resources.desc: Quadrotor racing dataset that contains information from even camera, RGB camera and groundtruth from Leica Nova MS60 laser tracker. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.

resources.name: PartNet
resources.desc: A consistent, large-scale dataset of 3D objects annotated with fine-grained, instance-level, and hierarchical 3D part information. The dataset consists of 573,585 part instances over 26,671 3D models covering 24 object categories. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: UTBM Robocar dataset
resources.desc: A dataset containing a robotic car sensor data. In the provided ROS bag files we can find information from 2 stereo cameras, 3 lidars, radar, GNSS receiver with RTK base station, IMU and 2 RGB cameras. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

resources.name: UrbanLoco
resources.desc: Another robotic car dataset providing sensor information as a ROS bag. Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

resources.name: LIBRE-dataset
resources.desc: LiDAR Benchmark Reference dataset comparing 12 LiDAR models across various scenarios and conditions for self-driving cars.

resources.name: USTC FLICAR Dataset
resources.desc: a heavy-duty VTOL dataset captured by a robotic bucket truck.

resources.name: Open X-Embodiment Dataset
resources.desc: A large open-source real robot dataset. It contains 1M+ real robot trajectories spanning 22 robot embodiments, from single robot arms to bi-manual robots and quadrupeds.

resources.name: L2D Dataset
resources.desc: A huge dataset captured by driving schools in Germany. Article desribing this work in more detail can be found here.

resources.name: ArduPilot
resources.desc: Open Source autopilot for multirotors, fixed wings, rovers, boats and submarines. Runs on following autopilot hardware. Licence: GPLv3.

resources.name: PX4
resources.desc: PX4 is an open source flight control software for drones and other unmanned vehicles. The project provides a flexible set of tools for drone developers to share technologies to create tailored solutions for drone applications. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: Paparazzi
resources.desc: Open-source drone hardware and software project encompassing autopilot systems and ground station software for multicopters/multirotors, fixed-wing, helicopters and hybrid aircraft that was founded in 2003. Licence: GPLv2.

resources.name: Rerun
resources.desc: An SDK for logging computer vision and robotics data paired with a visualizer for exploring that data over time. It lets you debug and understand the internal state and data of your systems with minimal code. Licence: Dual licence under MIT OR Apache-2.0.

resources.name: GTSAM
resources.desc: a BSD-licensed C++ library that implements sensor fusion for robotics and computer vision applications, including SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping), VO (Visual Odometry), and SFM (Structure from Motion). It uses factor graphs and Bayes networks as the underlying computing paradigm rather than sparse matrices to optimize for the most probable configuration or an optimal plan. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: Ceres Solver
resources.desc: An open source C++ library for modeling and solving large, complicated optimization problems, used by many organizations for bundle adjustment, SLAM, camera calibration and many other robotics-based applications. Licence: BSD-3 Clause.

resources.name: Visual Servoing Platform
resources.desc: This project is a cross-platform library (Linux, Windows, Mac) that allows prototyping and developing applications using visual tracking and visual servoing technics. Licence: GPLv2.

resources.name: Point Cloud Library
resources.desc: Standalone, large scale, open project for 2D/3D image and point cloud processing. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: OpenCV
resources.desc: Open Source computer vision library. Licence: BSD-3 Clause.

resources.name: videoflow
resources.desc: Python framework that facilitates the quick development of complex video analysis applications and other series-processing based applications in a multiprocessing environment. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Robotics Library
resources.desc: Self-contained C++ library for rigid body kinematics and dynamics, motion planning, and control. Licence: BSD-2 Clause.

resources.name: openpose
resources.desc: Real-time multi-person keypoint detection library for body, face, hands, and foot estimation. Licence: permissible for non-profits and research organizations, commercial for for profit companies.

resources.name: Raisim
resources.desc: A physics for rigid-body dynamics simulation. Licence: Free for non-commercial use.

resources.name: Open Motion Planning Library
resources.desc: OMPL consists of many state-of-the-art sampling-based motion planning algorithms. Licence: BSD-3 Clause.

resources.name: evo
resources.desc: A Python package for the evaluation of odometry and SLAM. Licence: GPL-3.0.

resources.name: MRPT
resources.desc: Mobile Robot Programming Toolkit provides developers with portable and well-tested applications and libraries covering data structures and algorithms employed in common robotics research areas. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: MOOS
resources.desc: a C++ cross platform middle ware for robotics research. It is helpful to think about it as a set of layers.

resources.name: pinocchio
resources.desc: a fast and flexible implementation of Rigid Body Dynamics algorithms and their analytical derivatives. Licence: BSD-2 Clause.

resources.name: OpenSHC
resources.desc: a versatile multilegged robot controller capable of generating body poses and gaits for quasi-static multilegged robots. Licence: CSIRO Open Source Software Licence (variation of BSD / MIT).

resources.name: EXOTica
resources.desc: a general Optimisation Toolset for Robotics platforms, written in C++ with bindings for Python. Its motivation is to provide a more streamlined process for developing algorithms for tasks such as Inverse Kinematics, Trajectory Optimisation, and Optimal Control. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: Crocoddyl
resources.desc: an optimal control library for robot control under contact sequence. Its solver is based on various efficient Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP)-like algorithms. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: Open3D
resources.desc: an open-source library that supports rapid development of software that deals with 3D data. The Open3D frontend exposes a set of carefully selected data structures and algorithms in both C++ and Python. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Robotics Toolbox for Python
resources.desc: this toolbox brings robotics-specific functionality to Python, and leverages Python's advantages of portability, ubiquity and support, and the capability of the open-source ecosystem for linear algebra (numpy, scipy), graphics (matplotlib, three.js, WebGL), interactive development (jupyter, jupyterlab, mybinder.org), and documentation (sphinx). Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Fields2Cover
resources.desc: A modular and extensible Coverage Path Planning library. Licence: BSD-3-Clause.

resources.name: Segment Anything
resources.desc: The Segment Anything Model (SAM) produces high quality object masks from input prompts such as points or boxes, and it can be used to generate masks for all objects in an image. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: LeRobot
resources.desc: Developped by Hugging Face, LeRobot provides models, datasets and tools for real-world robotics in PyTorch. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: LiveKit
resources.desc: LiveKit is an open-source WebRTC SFU & SDKs to enable low-latency realtime streaming of video, audio, & data. SDKs available in Rust, Python, C++, Javascript, Swift, Kotlin, Unity, Flutter, ESP32. License: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Cartographer
resources.desc: 2D and 3D SLAM library, supports multiple platforms and sensor configurations. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: GMapping
resources.desc: GMapping is a highly efficient Rao-Blackwellized particle filer to learn grid maps from laser range data. Licence: BSD-3-Clause.

resources.name: hector_slam
resources.desc: hector_slam contains ROS packages related to performing SLAM in unstructured environments like those encountered in the Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) scenarios of the RoboCup Rescue competition. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: TinySLAM
resources.desc: This package provides ROS implentation of the tinySLAM that is one of the most simpliest and lightweight SLAM methods. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: xivo
resources.desc: A library for visual-inertial odometry and mapping. It's free for research and educational applications, a commercial licence is available on request.

resources.name: slam_toolbox
resources.desc: A ROS package for 2D lifelong mapping and localization in potentially massive maps. Licence: LGPL v2.1.

resources.name: Kimera
resources.desc: C++ library for real-time metric-semantic simultaneous localization and mapping. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: LaMA
resources.desc: A lightweight Localization and Mapping library. Should run on Rasberry Pi 3B+. Licence: BSD-3 Clause.

resources.name: RTAB-Map
resources.desc: RTAB-Map (Real-Time Appearance-Based Mapping) is a RGB-D, Stereo and Lidar Graph-Based SLAM approach based on an incremental appearance-based loop closure detector. Licence depends on the build type and usage, please see website for more details.

resources.name: Basalt
resources.desc: Library for visual-inertial odometry and mapping. Licence: BSD-3 Clause.

resources.name: LIO-SAM
resources.desc: A real-time lidar-inertial odometry package with very promising results for multi-beam LiDARS. Licence: BSD-3 Clause.

resources.name: v-rep
resources.desc: A robot simulator with integrated development environment. Based on a distributed control architecture: each object/model can be individually controlled via an embedded script, a plugin, a ROS or BlueZero node, a remote API client, or a custom solution. It comes in free educational or paid commercial versions.

resources.name: ARGoS
resources.desc: ARGoS is a multi-physics robot simulator. It can simulate large-scale swarms of robots of any kind efficiently. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Gazebo
resources.desc: Open Source simulator that plays nicely with ROS developed by OSRF. Supports 4 physics engines. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Webots
resources.desc: Free and open source simulator that includes a large collection of robots, sensors, actuators and objects model.s Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: CARLA
resources.desc: Open-source simulator for autonomous driving research. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: AirSim
resources.desc: A simulator for drones, cars and more, built on Unreal Engine and made by Microsoft. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: OpenRAVE
resources.desc: OpenRAVE provides an environment for testing, developing, and deploying motion planning algorithms in real-world robotics applications. The main focus is on simulation and analysis of kinematic and geometric information related to motion planning. Licence: LGPL v.3.0.

resources.name: Flightmare
resources.desc: An Open Flexible Quadrotor Simulator. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: pyrobosim
resources.desc: ROS2 enabled 2D mobile robot simulator for behavior prototyping. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: mvsim
resources.desc: lightweight, dnyamical simulator for 2D vehicles and robots. Licence: BSD-3 Clause.

resources.name: Isaac Sim
resources.desc: Proprietary simulator from NVIDIA with advanced physics, AI-based features, and GPU-accelerated capabilities.

resources.name: ROS
resources.desc: The Robot Operating System (ROS) is a set of software libraries and tools that help you build robot applications. From drivers to state-of-the-art algorithms, and with powerful developer tools, ROS has what you need for your next robotics project.

resources.name: MOOS-IvP
resources.desc: MOOS-IvP is a set of open source C++ modules for providing autonomy on robotic platforms, in particular autonomous marine vehicles.

resources.name: YARP
resources.desc: Yet Another Robot Platform middleware for robotics.

resources.name: Viam
resources.desc: Viam is an open source software platform that's modular, pluggable, and designed to work with any hardware with sensing, compute, and actuation.

resources.name: DORA
resources.desc: middleware designed to streamline and simplify the creation of AI-based robotic applications. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Copper
resources.desc: Copper is a user-friendly runtime engine for creating fast and reliable robots. Copper is to robots what a game engine is to games. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: towr
resources.desc: A light-weight, Eigen-based C++ library for trajectory optimization for legged robots. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: BehaviourTree.CPP
resources.desc: Behavior Trees Library in C++. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: PlotJuggler
resources.desc: QT5 based application to display time series in plots, using an intuitive "drag and drop" interface. Licence: GPLv3.

resources.name: rosshow
resources.desc: Visualize ROS topics inside a terminal with Unicode/ASCII art. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: Astrobee Robot Software
resources.desc: NASA Astrobee Robot Software. Licence: Apache v2.0.

resources.name: vector_ros
resources.desc: ROS package for Anki Vector home robot. Licence: GPLv3.0.

resources.name: SMACC
resources.desc: an event-driven, asynchronous, behavioral state machine library for real-time ROS (Robotic Operating System) applications written in C++. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: Robot-Runner
resources.desc: Robot Runner (RR) is a tool to automatically execute measurement-based experiments on robotics software. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Allan Variance ROS
resources.desc: ROS package which loads a rosbag of IMU data and computes Allan Variance parameters. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: Voxgraph
resources.desc: Globally consistent volumetric mapping framework. It represents the world as a collection of Signed Distance Function submaps, which it aligns through pose graph optimization. Licence: BSD 2-Clause.

resources.name: Wavemap
resources.desc: Fast, efficient and accurate multi-resolution, multi-sensor 3D occupancy mapping. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: jupyetlab-urdf
resources.desc: An extension to display URDF in JupyterLab. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: Quad-SDK
resources.desc: ROS-based framework for agile quadrupedal locomotion. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Aerostack2
resources.desc: framework that helps developers design and build the control architecture of aerial robotic systems. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: race_stack
resources.desc: full stack for F1TENTH autonomous scaled cars based on ROS 1. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: ROS 2 Benchmark Container
resources.desc: A Dockerized performance benchmarking suite for ROS 2 that automates testing, comparative analysis, and report generation across multiple RMW implementations and system topologies. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: ros2_medkit
resources.desc: Structured fault management for ROS 2 — persistent fault lifecycle, REST/SSE API, root cause correlation, and automatic rosbag capture on fault. Inspired by SOVD (Service-Oriented Vehicle Diagnostics), the ASAM standard that brings HTTP/REST diagnostics to automotive and robotics. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: FusionCore
resources.desc: ROS 2 UKF sensor fusion for IMU, wheel encoders and GPS. 22-state filter with ECEF-native GPS handling, automatic IMU bias estimation, adaptive noise covariance and chi-squared outlier rejection on every sensor. Benchmarked against robot_localization EKF on 6 NCLT public dataset sequences. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: ROSflight
resources.desc: ROSflight is an autopilot system designed from the ground up with researchers in mind, and for easy integration with ROS. Licence: BSD 3-Clause.

resources.name: rpg_quadrotor_control
resources.desc: A complete framework for flying quadrotors based on control algorithms developed by the Robotics and Perception Group at University of Zurich.

resources.name: roslibjs
resources.desc: A standard ROS JavaScript library. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: web_video_server
resources.desc: HTTP Streaming of ROS Image Topics in Multiple Formats. Licence: BSD.

resources.name: Webviz
resources.desc: A web based application for playback and visualization of ROS bag files made by Cruise Automation. Licence: Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Transitive
resources.desc: A full-stack framework for robotic capabilities that connect robot, cloud, and web. License: Apache-2.0.

resources.name: transAct
resources.desc: An open-source robot fleet management dashboard. License: Apache-2.0.

resources.name: Autoware
resources.desc: The Autoware Foundation is a non-profit organization supporting open-source projects enabling self-driving mobility.

resources.name: ROS-Industrial
resources.desc: ROS-Industrial is an open-source project that extends the advanced capabilities of ROS software to industrial relevant hardware and applications.

resources.name: VESC
resources.desc: An open source ESC project. Quite commonly used in electronics skateboard community but also used in projects such as MIT RACECAR and MuSHR.

resources.name: ODrive
resources.desc: "A hobby motor for robotics". Can control two motors at the same time. Licence: MIT (Hardware, Software).

resources.name: STMBL
resources.desc: AC Servo Driver for STM32F4. Licence: GPLv3.

resources.name: SimpleFOC
resources.desc: Arduino Compatible Open Source Field Oriented Control (FOC) project. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: WireViz
resources.desc: A tool for documenting cables, wiring harnesses and connector pinouts by describing them in YAML format. Licence: GPLv3.0.

resources.name: PythonRobotics
resources.desc: Python sample codes for robotics algorithms. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: Kalman and Bayesian Filters in Python
resources.desc: Kalman Filter book using Jupyter Notebook. Focuses on building intuition and experience, not formal proofs. Includes Kalman filters, extended Kalman filters, unscented Kalman filters, particle filters, and more. All exercises include solutions. Licence: CC.

resources.name: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
resources.desc: Free course on neural networks from fast.ai. Currently it contains 14 lessons.

resources.name: A Machine Learning Course with Python
resources.desc: Freely available Machine Learning course using Python developed by Machine Learning Mindset.

resources.name: Robotics 501: Mathematics for Robotics
resources.desc: ROB 501: Mathematics for Robotics, is a graduate-level course at the University of Michigan that introduces applied mathematics for robotics engineers.

resources.name: Calibration Desk Reference
resources.desc: an 80 page long document on sensor calibration from Tangram Vision with a direct download link on the website.

resources.name: Elements of Robotics
resources.desc: Open access book on robotics, directed towards beginners. The book has many algorithmic activities and exercises.

resources.name: Foundations of Robotics
resources.desc: an Open-access book on robotics, rather for beginners.

resources.name: Flying planes with JavaScript
resources.desc: a tutorials on integrating with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 API that ends with developing some autopilot-like functionality.

resources.name: Interactive PCL Tutorial
resources.desc: Interactive tutorials for the Point Cloud Library covering filters, normal estimation, segmentation, clustering, ICP, and more.

resources.name: Examples of AI Gaming the Rules
resources.desc: Sometimes it's convenient for the algorithm to pause the simulation to get the highest score. This spreadsheet contains lots of information of this kind.

resources.name: OSRTOS
resources.desc: A list of open source Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS). Licence: CC BY-SA 3.0.

resources.name: Haptipedia
resources.desc: An online, open-source, visualization of a growing database of 105+ haptic devices invented since 1992.

resources.name: Board-DB
resources.desc: A searchable database of single board computers.

resources.name: A fast introduction to Robotics (v 2.0)
resources.desc: A hand-picked selection of Robotics resources covering robotics from various angles.

resources.name: ContinuumRobotExamples
resources.desc: Continuum robots have elastic links which are capable of large-scale continuous deformations. This repo has example scripts to simulate continuum robots of various design paradigms. Each example is accompanied by a short write-up in PDF format. Licence: MIT.

resources.name: AI Incident Database
resources.desc: a well documented database of AI incidents.

resources.name: ROS Robotics Companies
resources.desc: a list of companies using ROS 1 or ROS 2.

resources.name: Control Challenges
resources.desc: a set of control challanges that you can solve in the browser using Javascript.

resources.name: Robotics Conferences and School List
resources.desc: lists of robotics-related conferences and summer/winter schools.

resources.name: Arduino Library
resources.desc: A library of thousands of Arduino libraries that contains a powerful search capabilities.

resources.name: Pulling Power from the Sky: The Story of Makani
resources.desc: A documentary on Makani, a company that was producing energy from wind using kites.

resources.name: How to Start a Robot Revolution
resources.desc: a Red Hat documentary on ROS.
